category: uptime monitoring and status pages, with log, trace and metric storage and error tracking

free_tier.stated: Free for personal projects (USD 0/month): 10 monitors and 10 heartbeats with 3-minute checks, 1 status page, Slack and e-mail alerts, 100,000 exceptions per month, 5,000 session replays, 3 GB logs retained for 3 days, 3 GB traces retained for 3 days, 30 GB metrics, 3 GB web events retained for 3 days; no credit card
free_tier.notes: The allowance mixes object counts (monitors, heartbeats, exceptions, session replays) and ingested bytes (3 GB per month each of logs, traces and web events, 30 GB of metrics), so no single unit of the vocabulary fits. The check frequency ranges from 3 minutes on free plans to 30 seconds on paid plans. Logs beyond the allowance cost USD 0.10 per GB ingested in Europe, USD 0.15 in the United States and USD 0.35 in Singapore.

per_object_cap.stated: unverified: no per-log-line or per-event size is stated on the pages read

retention.stated: Logs, traces and web events: 3 GB per month retained for 3 days on the free plan. Exceptions and session replays: 90 days.
retention.notes: The 3-day window applies to the telemetry kept on the free plan; paid telemetry bundles include 30-day log retention.

egress.terms: unverified: no egress term on the pages read; logs and metrics are read back through a read-only HTTP SQL API

interface_detail: The Uptime (Incidents) API follows JSON:API with an Authorization: Bearer token, global or per team; logs and metrics are queried through a read-only HTTP SQL API with a username and password made per connection. The API host uptime.betterstack.com answered 401 to /api/v2/monitors without a token. Whether the SQL API is open on the free plan is unverified: behind a sign-up.
tooling: curl or any HTTP client with a Bearer token, the Better Stack Terraform provider, and Prometheus or OpenTelemetry collectors for metrics
chaining: An external check every 3 minutes on up to 10 endpoints of free compute services, with heartbeats for scheduled jobs and a 3-day window of logs for debugging.

limits.value: uptime checks every 3 minutes at the shortest on the free plan
logs, traces and web events retained for 3 days
3 GB of logs, 3 GB of traces and 3 GB of web events per month, 30 GB of metrics, 100,000 exceptions per month, 5,000 session replays

binding_note: Logs, traces and web events older than 3 days are deleted, so the free telemetry is a 3-day debugging window whatever the volume; the 10-monitor count binds the uptime side.

identity_cost.detail: The sign-up form asks for an e-mail address and sends a magic link; Better Stack's own comparison page states the free plan needs no credit card. Whether a later step asks for a phone number is unverified: behind a sign-up.

reliability_note: Logs, traces and web events are deleted after 3 days on the free plan.
confidence_note: Every limit is quoted from a first-party page, and the API host answered 401 without a token. No account was opened, so the free plan's API access and any later sign-up step are unverified; an authenticated API call from a free account would move it to measured.
